subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `openclaw memory status` treat persisted `vectorDims` as enough to report the builtin vector store as ready when the current process has not loaded sqlite-vec?
rationale: The code path is technically coherent, but the status contract is compatibility-sensitive because scripts or operators may read `storeAvailable` as a live current-process probe result.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing while `--deep` remains the live sqlite-vec and embedding probe.

options.title: Expose A Separate Indexed Signal
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps `storeAvailable` live-probe-only and adds or renames a separate indexed-vector status field or line.

options.title: Pause For A Different Canonical Fix
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR if maintainers want a different status contract or wording before changing CLI/JSON output.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing while `--deep` remains the live sqlite-vec and embedding probe.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is assigned on the live PR and has recent memory database/index migration history around the same status metadata surface.
